name: terrain-instrument-ui-gates
description: fb601 — the ONE dependency the JS UI gates in this directory need. Installed HERE (Tests/node_modules) on purpose: node resolves a bare require() from the requiring FILE's directory upward, so `node Tests/harm_waterfall_gate.js` finds it with no NODE_PATH, from any cwd.

scripts.postinstall: node -e "try{require.resolve('puppeteer-core');console.log('[ui-gates] puppeteer-core '+require('puppeteer-core/package.json').version+' resolvable from Tests/ — the JS gates will RUN')}catch(e){console.error('[ui-gates] puppeteer-core NOT resolvable — the JS gates would silently MODULE_NOT_FOUND');process.exit(1)}"
